lines: In the scenery I've been gazing at
The world, transformed since you entered it
Right in the middle of days I always handled without a hitch
I can't resist the strange pull, and I'm falling apart
I LOVE... — I start to say it, then stop
I LOVE... I LOVE... over and over
In the swelling love, in the shifting feelings
Your figure shines brilliantly
Like diving into an aquarium
Like paint dissolved in water
An irregular
Alone, I never would have noticed a single thing
In colors this vivid
I started to tell you, you who shrug it off as nothing special
I LOVE — let me give you the rest of that sentence
You see what can't be seen, and laugh
And there's a part of me that can't leave your side
You're too beautiful — it blinds me
Even now I live bound by my own inferiority
I love... I love... this clumsy knot
I love... I love... found by groping hands
I love Your love — untangling, tangling again
I keep going through it, over and over
A galaxy decorated with nothing but replicas
Darkness made of curtains
In a mouse-gray city where no one even grieves
I love — I hold that proof close
Joy, sorrow, feelings without pause or period
Rather than sharing them perfectly
Even while struggling through the ambiguity
If we could accept each other
In the love that overlaps, in the murky emotions
In the sliver of a moment between blinks
The present you gave me
Is this world, gentle beyond all reason
An irregular
Alone, I never would have noticed a single thing
In a light this precious
I started to tell you, you who shrug it off as nothing special
I love — let me give you the rest of that sentence
The two of us, receiving each other
A night without a name deepens on
